sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在加利福尼亚州的一座葡萄园里，人们发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份却让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是“档案档案呈献”的全新系列，现已在各大播客平台上线。

sentences.en: February 5, 1921 was far from a typical Saturday afternoon in the valley town of Abertilere, Wales.
sentences.zh: 1921年2月5日，对威尔士山谷小镇阿伯蒂勒来说，绝不是一个普通的周六下午。

sentences.en: Locals had rallied together to undertake a desperate search.
sentences.zh: 当地人聚在一起，展开了一场绝望的搜寻。

sentences.en: Shops and residences along the main street were checked, as were the narrow alleyways between them.
sentences.zh: 主街沿线的商店和住宅受到了检查，它们之间的狭窄小巷也是如此。

sentences.en: Men and their sons ventured off into the surrounding hills, while others trekked the lengths of the railway tracks and the nearby Ebba River.
sentences.zh: 男人们和他们的儿子们冒险进入周围的山丘，而其他人则沿着铁路线和附近的埃巴河走遍了全程。

sentences.en: Their efforts were in vain.
sentences.zh: 他们的努力付诸东流。

sentences.en: But they didn't give up.
sentences.zh: 但他们没有放弃。

sentences.en: As the dull skies gave way to night, people were still searching.
sentences.zh: 当阴沉的天空被夜幕笼罩时，人们仍在搜寻。

sentences.en: They were joined by the town crier, who paraded up and down the main street, shouting the name of the eight-year-old girl who had vanished from town that morning.
sentences.zh: 镇上的宣告员也加入了他们的行列，他在主街上来回游行，大声喊着那个那天早上在镇上失踪的八岁女孩的名字。

sentences.en: Frida Burnell
sentences.zh: 弗里达·伯内尔

sentences.en: Frida Burnell
sentences.zh: 弗里达·伯内尔

sentences.en: Hours earlier, Frida Burnell had been skipping down Somerset Street into Abertilere's bustling town centre.
sentences.zh: 几个小时前，弗里达·伯内尔还蹦蹦跳跳地沿着萨默塞特街走进了阿伯蒂勒熙熙攘攘的市中心。

sentences.en: The sight of little Frida, in her black buttoned boots, red cap and brown coat, all by herself, didn't raise any eyebrows.
sentences.zh: 小弗里达独自一人穿着黑色的扣式靴子、戴着红帽子、穿着棕色外套，这并没有引起任何人的侧目。

sentences.en: The coal mining town she called home was small, and locals trusted each other.
sentences.zh: 她称之为家的这座煤矿小镇很小，当地人彼此信任。

sentences.en: Frida was running an errand for her father, who was in need of some feed and poultry grit for the chickens they owned.
sentences.zh: 弗里达正在为父亲跑腿，他需要一些饲料和家禽砂砾来喂养他们养的鸡。

sentences.en: He had promised his daughter a penny as a reward for buying the supplies on his behalf.
sentences.zh: 他曾承诺给女儿一便士作为代购物资的奖励。

sentences.en: At around 9am, the bell at the top of the front door of Mortimer's store jingled as Frida entered.
sentences.zh: 大约早上9点，当弗里达走进莫蒂默商店时，前门顶部的铃铛叮当作响。

sentences.en: The shop specialised in livestock supplies, and while they had the chicken feed Frida requested, there weren't any sacks of grit, only loose grit.
sentences.zh: 这家商店专门经营牲畜用品，虽然他们有弗里达要求的鸡饲料，但没有任何袋装砂砾，只有散装砂砾。

sentences.en: Frida said she would go home to ask her father if that would suffice, and if so, she would come back.
sentences.zh: 弗里达说她要回家问问父亲这样是否可以，如果可以，她就会回来。

sentences.en: But she never returned.
sentences.zh: 但她再也没有回来。

sentences.en: By late afternoon, Abertilere's locals were assisting police and the Burnell family in trying to locate Frida.
sentences.zh: 到了傍晚，阿伯蒂勒的当地人协助警察和伯内尔一家寻找弗里达。

sentences.en: Somehow, during her journey home from Mortimer's store, she had vanished without a trace.
sentences.zh: 不知何故，在她从莫蒂默商店回家的路上，她消失得无影无踪。

sentences.en: The following morning, a local coal worker finished his shift in the mines and began the walk back to his home.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，当地一名煤矿工人结束了矿井的轮班，开始步行回家。

sentences.en: As he approached Abertilere's town centre, he headed down a narrow side alley, where he stumbled across a hessian sack discarded in the mud.
sentences.zh: 当他接近阿伯蒂勒市中心时，他走进了一条狭窄的侧巷，在那里他偶然发现了一个被丢弃在泥土里的麻袋。

sentences.en: It clearly held something.
sentences.zh: 它里面明显装着东西。

sentences.en: The coal worker examined the sack closely.
sentences.zh: 煤矿工人仔细检查了麻袋。

sentences.en: Inside, was the body of 8-year-old Frida Burnell.
sentences.zh: 里面装着8岁女孩弗里达·伯内尔的尸体。

sentences.en: Her remains had been dumped just 90 metres from her house.
sentences.zh: 她的遗体被丢弃在距离她家仅90米的地方。

sentences.en: Frida had sustained a violent blow to the head, but it was the cord still wrapped around her neck that had caused her death.
sentences.zh: 弗里达的头部遭受了猛烈的撞击，但真正导致她死亡的是依然缠在她脖子上的绳索。

sentences.en: A piece of cloth was stuffed inside her mouth, and her wrists and ankles were tied behind her back with rope.
sentences.zh: 她的嘴里塞着一块布，手腕和脚踝用绳子反绑在背后。

sentences.en: Her attacker had also attempted to rape her.
sentences.zh: 她的袭击者还曾试图强奸她。

sentences.en: The shocking murder rattled the typically carefree townsfolk.
sentences.zh: 这起骇人听闻的谋杀案震惊了平日里无忧无虑的镇民。

sentences.en: Frida's funeral was held on the street outside her home to facilitate the large crowds of mourners that wished to attend.
sentences.zh: 弗里达的葬礼在她家门外的街道上举行，以方便想要参加的大量哀悼者。

sentences.en: They circled around her small coffin, their sense of loss tinged with fear, as they wondered who among them would carry out such a violent and disturbing crime.
sentences.zh: 他们围在她的小棺材周围，内心的失落感夹杂着恐惧，他们纳闷到底是谁在他们当中犯下了如此暴力和令人不安的罪行。

sentences.en: In a desperate bid to identify Frida's killer, locals carried out a séance.
sentences.zh: 为了绝望地找出弗里达的凶手，当地人举行了一场降神会。

sentences.en: In the 1920s, it was widely believed that such acts allowed communication with spirits who might be able to provide crucial information.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪20年代，人们普遍认为这种行为可以与可能提供关键信息的灵魂进行交流。

sentences.en: According to one participant, the séance succeeded, with the spirits offering a description of Frida's murderer.
sentences.zh: 据一位参与者称，降神会成功了，灵魂提供了对弗里达凶手的描述。

sentences.en: This description just so happened to match that of a man seen loitering near the alley shortly before her body was found there.
sentences.zh: 这个描述恰好与在她的尸体在那里被发现之前不久，被看到在小巷附近徘徊的一个男人的特征相符。

sentences.en: He was an outsider and not known to the townspeople, between 30 to 40 years of age, approximately 5 feet 6 inches tall, with dark hair and a heavy moustache.
sentences.zh: 他是一个外地人，镇上的人不认识他，年龄在30到40岁之间，身高大约5英尺6英寸，留着深色头发和浓密的胡须。

sentences.en: He was wearing dark breeches, a lounge coat and carrying a stick.
sentences.zh: 他穿着深色马裤，休闲西装，手里拿着一根棍子。

sentences.en: The information obtained via the séance was taken seriously at the time, but local authorities sought further evidence.
sentences.zh: 通过降神会获得的信息在当时被严肃对待，但当地当局寻求进一步的证据。

sentences.en: This type of crime was unheard of in Abitillery and was beyond their expertise, so they requested assistance from London's experienced and well-equipped Scotland Yard police force.
sentences.zh: 这种类型的犯罪在阿比蒂利前所未闻，超出了他们的专业知识，因此他们向伦敦经验丰富、装备精良苏格兰场警察部队请求支援。

sentences.en: Two detectives soon arrived in town to carry out an investigation.
sentences.zh: 两名侦探很快抵达镇上开展调查。

sentences.en: It was determined that Frida was murdered between 9.30am and 1pm on the day she went missing.
sentences.zh: 经确定，弗里达是在她失踪当天的上午9点30分至下午1点之间遇害的。

sentences.en: Her body was found in close proximity to a shed used by Mortimer's store, which contained stock too large to fit on the shop floor.
sentences.zh: 她的尸体被发现紧邻莫蒂默商店使用的一个棚屋，里面存放着太大而无法放在店面里的存货。

sentences.en: Multiple witnesses said that shortly after Frida left Mortimer's, they heard screams coming from the direction of the storage shed, but assumed it was just children playing.
sentences.zh: 多名目击者称，在弗里达离开莫蒂默商店后不久，他们听到储藏棚方向传来尖叫声，但以为只是小孩子们在玩耍。

sentences.en: A resident who lived near the building heard what she described as a muffled, funny-sounding argument between 9.20 and 9.30am.
sentences.zh: 一位住在该建筑附近的居民听到她所描述的在上午9点20分到9点30分之间一场闷声闷气、听起来很奇怪的争吵。

sentences.en: She thought it was her son in the backyard herding one of their chickens.
sentences.zh: 她以为是她的儿子在后院赶着他们的一只鸡。

sentences.en: But when she headed outside to check, she found her son playing in a nearby lane.
sentences.zh: 但当她走到外面查看时，她发现她的儿子正在附近的小路上玩耍。

sentences.en: On the floor of the Mortimer's shed were loose pieces of corn chaff, matching shards recovered from Frida's skin and the sack she was found in.
sentences.zh: 莫蒂默棚屋的地板上散落着玉米糠碎片，与从弗里达皮肤和发现她所在的麻袋上回收的碎屑相吻合。

sentences.en: A small handkerchief that Frida was carrying the day she was attacked was also discovered in the shed.
sentences.zh: 弗里达在遭受袭击那天随身携带的一个小手帕也在棚屋里被发现。

sentences.en: As was an axe.
sentences.zh: 还有一把斧头。

sentences.en: It was hidden under a sack.
sentences.zh: 它藏在麻袋下面。

sentences.en: And while the blade itself was clean, the handle was covered in wet blood.
sentences.zh: 虽然斧刃本身很干净，但斧柄上沾满了湿血。

sentences.en: The shed was 275 metres from Mortimer's store, which was owned and operated by its namesake, a local man named Herbert Mortimer.
sentences.zh: 该棚屋距离莫蒂默商店275米，该商店由同名的当地人赫伯特·莫蒂默拥有和经营。

sentences.en: Herbert had a strong alibi for the day of Frida's murder, with multiple witnesses confirming his whereabouts at the time she was attacked.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特对弗里达被谋杀那天有强有力的不在场证明，多名目击者证实了她遇袭时他的行踪。

sentences.en: As for his storage shed, Herbert revealed that it was kept locked at all times and that there were only two keys that granted access.
sentences.zh: 至于他的储藏棚，赫伯特透露它一直保持上锁状态，并且只有两把钥匙可以进入。

sentences.en: Herbert carried one.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特随身携带一把。

sentences.en: The other was held by one of his employees, 15-year-old Harold Jones.
sentences.zh: 另一把由他的一个员工、15岁的哈罗德·琼斯保管。

sentences.en: Harold was at the front counter when Frida visited Mortimer's on February 5.
sentences.zh: 2月5日弗里达造访莫蒂默时，哈罗德正在前台柜台。

sentences.en: She arrived shortly after 9am and only spent around two minutes in the store.
sentences.zh: 她刚过9点到达，在店里只呆了大约两分钟。

sentences.en: Harold didn't notice which direction she headed in upon exiting the shop.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德没有注意到她出店后朝哪个方向走去。

sentences.en: Herbert Mortimer vouched for his young staff member, telling detectives that Harold Jones was at the store nearly all morning.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特·莫蒂默为他的年轻员工作证，告诉侦探哈罗德·琼斯几乎整个上午都在店里。

sentences.en: Herbert's wife supported this assertion.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特的妻子证实了这一说法。

sentences.en: She had been in their apartment above the shop and could hear Harold banging his foot against the wood panelling of the counter, something he did constantly as he walked.
sentences.zh: 她当时在商店上面的公寓里，能听到哈罗德用脚踢柜台木质镶板的声音，这是他走路时经常做的一个动作。

sentences.en: According to Herbert, Harold only left once for a short period at 10am, almost an hour after Frida Burnell had stopped by.
sentences.zh: 据赫伯特说，哈罗德在上午10点左右只离开过一次很短的时间，这几乎是在弗里达·伯内尔光顾后一个小时。

sentences.en: He'd been tasked with retrieving some stock from the shed, but the teenager didn't go alone.
sentences.zh: 他的任务是从棚屋里取回一些存货，但这个少年并不是一个人去的。

sentences.en: Herbert's 10-year-old son, Francis, joined him.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特的10岁儿子弗朗西斯加入了他的行列。

sentences.en: The pair made the short walk together, collected a sack of potatoes from the shed and delivered them to a nearby address before returning to the store.
sentences.zh: 两人一起短距离步行，从棚屋里取出一袋土豆，将它们送到附近的地址，然后返回店里。

sentences.en: Later that day, when word spread that Frida Burnell was missing,
sentences.zh: 那天晚些时候，当弗里达·伯内尔失踪的消息传开时，

sentences.en: Harold slid his hand into his pocket, only to realise that he didn't have the key to the shed on him.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德把手伸进口袋，却意识到自己身上没有棚屋的钥匙。

sentences.en: Realisation dawned that he must have left it in the shed's door after running the errand with Francis Mortimer hours earlier.
sentences.zh: 他突然意识到自己一定是几个小时前和弗朗西斯·莫蒂默跑完腿后把它遗忘在棚屋门上了。

sentences.en: Harold kept news of the misplaced key to himself, avoiding the fuss that would arise if his employer knew of his mistake.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德把放错钥匙的消息藏在心里，以免他的雇主知道他的错误而引发大惊小怪。

sentences.en: Later on, while helping look for Frida, Harold went back to the shed with Francis Mortimer and another local teen and was able to retrieve the key.
sentences.zh: 后来，在协助寻找弗里达时，哈罗德和弗朗西斯·莫蒂默以及另一个当地少年回到了棚屋，并成功找回了钥匙。

sentences.en: He didn't notice anything suspicious around the building at the time.
sentences.zh: 当时他没有注意到建筑周围有任何可疑之处。

sentences.en: Harold's story of leaving the key in the shed door opened the investigation up to many potential suspects.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德关于将钥匙留在棚屋门上的说法使调查面临许多潜在的嫌疑人。

sentences.en: Anyone could have taken Frida into the secluded building upon realising it was accessible.
sentences.zh: 任何人只要意识到可以进入，就可以把弗里达带进这个偏僻的建筑里。

sentences.en: Yet, despite having a strong alibi, Harold Jones was eyed by Scotland Yard as a prime suspect in the case.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管有强有力的不在场证明，苏格兰场仍然将哈罗德·琼斯视为本案的主要嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The 15-year-old knew Frida Burnell personally, as she was friends with his little sister, Flossie.
sentences.zh: 这个15岁的男孩认识弗里达·伯内尔，因为她是他的小妹妹弗洛西的朋友。

sentences.en: Consequently, a level of trust existed between Harold and Frida, which meant he could have easily convinced her to go to the shed.
sentences.zh: 因此，哈罗德和弗里达之间存在一定程度的信任，这意味着他很容易就能说服她去棚屋。

sentences.en: The alleyway where she was later found had been searched the night she vanished, but the sack containing her remains was not spotted at that time.
sentences.zh: 她后来被发现的小巷在她失踪当晚已被搜查过，但当时并没有看到装着她遗体的麻袋。

sentences.en: Investigators suspected Harold had returned to the shed in the early hours and removed Frida's body under the cover of darkness,
sentences.zh: 调查人员怀疑哈罗德在清晨返回棚屋，在夜色的掩护下移走了弗里达的尸体，

sentences.en: before dumping it in the alley where it was discovered the following day.
sentences.zh: 然后将其抛在小巷里，并在第二天被发现。

sentences.en: But none of this made sense to Abba Taliri's residence.
sentences.zh: 但这一切对阿巴塔里里的居民来说都说不通。

sentences.en: Harold's employers vouched for his whereabouts at the time Frida was attacked.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德的雇主为他在弗里达遇袭时的行踪作证。

sentences.en: Furthermore, Harold's parents insisted that their son had been home all night.
sentences.zh: 此外，哈罗德的父母坚称他们的儿子整晚都在家。

sentences.en: As a means of obtaining additional income, the Jones family hosted a boarder who, due to a lack of space, actually slept in Harold's bed alongside him.
sentences.zh: 作为获得额外收入的一种方式，琼斯一家接待了一位寄宿者，由于空间不足，他实际上和哈罗德睡在同一张床上。

sentences.en: The boarder maintained that Harold had remained in their shared bed all night.
sentences.zh: 这位寄宿者坚称哈罗德整晚都待在他们共用的床上。

sentences.en: Despite the town coming to his support, Harold Jones was arrested on suspicion of Frida Burnell's murder
sentences.zh: 尽管小镇给予他支持，哈罗德·琼斯仍因涉嫌谋杀弗里达·伯内尔而被捕

sentences.en: and held at the Abba Taliri police station to await an inquest into the eight-year-old's death.
sentences.zh: 并被关押在阿巴塔里里警察局，等待对这名八岁女孩死因的死因研讯。

sentences.en: He adamantly denied any knowledge of the crime.
sentences.zh: 他坚决否认知道这起犯罪。

sentences.en: The grief that had washed over Abba Taliri following the murder was quickly replaced by outrage over the arrest of Harold,
sentences.zh: 谋杀案发生后笼罩阿巴塔里里的悲伤很快被逮捕哈罗德引发的愤怒所取代，

sentences.en: Harold, who was an exemplary young lad.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德是一个堪称楷模的年轻小伙。

sentences.en: Like many others in the community, he came from a coal mining family.
sentences.zh: 和社区里的许多人一样，他来自一个煤矿家庭。

sentences.en: The working-class Joneses made do with what they had and were immensely proud of their eldest son Harold, who was intelligent and well-read.
sentences.zh: 工人阶级的琼斯一家有什么用什么，并为他们的大儿子哈罗德感到无比自豪，他聪明而且博览群书。

sentences.en: He was very much loved by his parents, Philip and Eleanor, and neither he nor anyone in his family had any previous run-ins with the law.
sentences.zh: 他深受父母菲利普和埃莉诺的喜爱，他和他的家人都没有任何前科。

sentences.en: Harold was an inquisitive youth and had done very well at school, with his former principal describing him as a model student.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德是一个求知欲强的年轻人，在学校表现很好，他的前校长形容他是模范学生。

sentences.en: He loved to play the organ and practised regularly at home.
sentences.zh: 他喜欢弹风琴，并定期在家练习。

sentences.en: Harold left school at age 14, which was common at the time.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德14岁离开学校，这在当时很常见。

sentences.en: He avoided taking up work in the physically demanding and dangerous coal mines by securing a job as a shop boy for Mortimer's.
sentences.zh: 他通过为莫蒂默商店找到一份店员工的工作，避免了在体能要求高且危险的煤矿工作。

sentences.en: To mark his new employment, Harold had a photo taken of himself standing outside the store.
sentences.zh: 为了庆祝他的新工作，哈罗德拍了一张自己站在商店外面的照片。

sentences.en: It showed the slight teen immaculately dressed in a suit, complete with pocket watch and cap.
sentences.zh: 照片显示这个瘦小的少年身穿笔挺的西装，配有怀表和帽子。

sentences.en: Not one to have his photo taken often, Harold stood awkwardly before the camera, which captured his blank expression.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德不常拍照，他在镜头前显得很不自然，镜头捕捉到了他木然的表情。

sentences.en: Herbert Mortimer said Harold was an obedient and trustworthy employee, which was why he gave him a key to his storage shed.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特·莫蒂默说哈罗德是一个听话且值得信赖的员工，这就是为什么他把储藏棚的钥匙交给他。

sentences.en: Harold took great pride in his appearance, wearing a suit and clean white apron to work every day, and his friendly nature ensured he was well-liked by customers.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德非常注重自己的外表，每天上班都穿着西装和干净的白围裙，他友善的性格确保他深受顾客喜爱。

sentences.en: Outside of work, the popular Harold was never short of friends, and had started dating a girl just prior to his arreSt.
sentences.zh: 工作之余，受欢迎的哈罗德从不缺乏朋友，就在被捕前不久，他开始和一个女孩约会。

sentences.en: Still, the investigators from Scotland Yard were certain they had Frieda's killer in custody.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，苏格兰场的调查人员确信他们拘留了弗里达的凶手。

sentences.en: Local police supported their decision, much to the fury of the public.
sentences.zh: 当地警方支持他们的决定，这激起了公众的极大愤怒。

sentences.en: They knew an outsider was to blame.
sentences.zh: 他们知道是一个外地人该负责。

sentences.en: A coroner's inquest into the death of Frieda Burnell formally began a month after she was found.
sentences.zh: 在弗里达·伯内尔被发现一个月后，对她死因的验尸官研讯正式开始。

sentences.en: Its purpose was to determine whether Frieda's death was caused by willful murder, and if so, whether Harold Jones would face a criminal trial.
sentences.zh: 其目的是确定弗里达的死是否是由蓄意谋杀引起的，如果是，哈罗德·琼斯是否将面临刑事审判。

sentences.en: Due to a lack of scientific testing at the time, the evidence against Harold was largely circumstantial.
sentences.zh: 由于当时缺乏科学检测，针对哈罗德的证据在很大程度上是间接的。

sentences.en: Harold had spent the past month in a prison cell at Abitaleri Police Station.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德在阿比塔莱里警察局的牢房里度过了过去的一个月。

sentences.en: Upon taking the witness box, he looked nervous and had difficulty answering questions, often giving contradictory evidence.
sentences.zh: 一走上证人席，他看起来很紧张，回答问题有困难，经常给出矛盾的证据。

sentences.en: The prosecution took his anxious demeanour as a sign of guilt, and for four hours they continued to barrage him with questions.
sentences.zh: 控方将他焦急的举止视为有罪的迹象，并连续四个小时继续用问题轰炸他。

sentences.en: Multiple people testified in Harold's defence, including his employer, his parents, and the boarder who shared his bed, all in turn providing crucial alibis.
sentences.zh: 多人出庭为哈罗德辩护，包括他的雇主、他的父母以及和他同床共枕的寄宿者，他们轮流提供了关键的不在场证明。

sentences.en: Supporting his innocence were the reported sightings of a stick-wielding stranger with a moustache spotted on the corner of the alley where Frieda was later found.
sentences.zh: 支持他清白的是据报道有人看到一个挥舞着棍子、留着胡子的陌生人出现在后来发现弗里达的小巷拐角处。

sentences.en: This was the same man allegedly described by spirits during a seance that townsfolk held after the discovery of Frieda's body.
sentences.zh: 这就是镇民在发现弗里达尸体后举行降神会时，灵魂据称描述的同一个人。

sentences.en: The same spirits had also, apparently, provided the killer's name, which was written on a piece of paper, folded, and given to the coroner for his eyes only.
sentences.zh: 据称，同样的灵魂还提供了凶手的名字，它写在一张纸上，折叠起来，交给了验尸官个人查阅。

sentences.en: The jury at the centre of the inquest were left uncertain by the varying accounts and returned an open finding.
sentences.zh: 研讯核心的陪审团对不同的说法感到不确定，并给出了一个开放式裁决。

sentences.en: The coroner refused to accept this result and the jury were made to reconsider.
sentences.zh: 验尸官拒绝接受这一结果，陪审团被迫重新考虑。

sentences.en: They returned with an amended verdict, concluding that Frieda's cause of death was willful murder by some person or persons unknown.
sentences.zh: 他们带着修改后的裁决返回，得出结论认为弗里达的死因是由某些未知个人或多名个人造成的蓄意谋杀。

sentences.en: Bail for Harold Jones was refused and he was remanded in custody until April 5, when he would be brought before a magistrate to determine whether he would go to trial.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德·琼斯的保释被拒绝，他被还押候审，直至4月5日被带到地方法官面前以确定是否受审。

sentences.en: When asked if he had any response to the charges against him,
sentences.zh: 当被问及他对针对他的指控有何回应时，

sentences.en: Harold replied,
sentences.zh: 哈罗德回答道：

sentences.en: I know it looks black against me, but I never done it.
sentences.zh: 我知道这对我极其不利，但我绝对没有做过。

sentences.en: On April 5, he was ordered to stand trial for Frieda's murder.
sentences.zh: 4月5日，他被命令因谋杀弗里达接受审判。

sentences.en: Harold pleaded, not guilty.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德坚称无罪。

sentences.en: In the lead up to the trial,
sentences.zh: 在审判前夕，

sentences.en: Herbert Mortimer sought to investigate some of the circumstantial evidence that had implicated his young employee.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特·莫蒂默试图调查一些牵连他年轻员工的间接证据。

sentences.en: This included Frieda's handkerchief, which was found on the floor of the storage shed, cited as evidence that she was killed there.
sentences.zh: 这包括在储藏棚地板上找到的弗里达的手帕，被引为她在那里面被杀害的证据。

sentences.en: According to the Manchester Guardian,
sentences.zh: 据《曼彻斯特卫报》报道，

sentences.en: Herbert discovered that if he leaned through one of the windows, he could drop a handkerchief that landed very near to where Frieda's had been found.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特发现如果他把身体探进其中一个窗户，他可以扔下一块手帕，落下的位置非常接近弗里达手帕被发现的地方。

sentences.en: Although this failed to address the bloodied axe, the corn chaff, or multiple reports of a commotion from the shed after Frieda left the store,
sentences.zh: 尽管这未能解释血迹斑斑的斧头、玉米糠，或者弗里达离开商店后多次关于棚屋传来骚动的报告，

sentences.en: Herbert still believed Harold to be innocent.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特仍然相信哈罗德是清白的。

sentences.en: Herbert also recalled that when he first bought the shed, its previous owner had told him that she was missing a key and he would need to have another spare made.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特还回忆起他刚买下这个棚屋时，前主人曾告诉他她少了一把钥匙，他需要另外配一把备用钥匙。

sentences.en: This meant a third, unaccounted for key was still out there, which would grant its holder access to the shed.
sentences.zh: 这意味着第三把下落不明的钥匙仍然存在，持有者可以凭此进入棚屋。

sentences.en: On June 21, 1921, the trial against Harold Jones for the murder of Frieda Burnell commenced.
sentences.zh: 1921年6月21日，对哈罗德·琼斯谋杀弗里达·伯内尔的审判正式开始。

sentences.en: Harold received glowing character references from his family, his former school headmaster, and his boss,
sentences.zh: 哈罗德收到了来自他的家人、前学校校长以及他的老板的高度品行评价，

sentences.en: Herbert Mortimer.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特·莫蒂默。

sentences.en: Herbert stood by the alibi he had provided for Harold from the outset, maintaining that the teen was in his store at the time Frieda was attacked.
sentences.zh: 赫伯特坚持他从一开始就为哈罗德提供的不在场证明，坚称弗里达遇袭时这个少年正在他的店里。

sentences.en: When Harold took the stand, he appeared calm and performed much better than at the inquest, answering questions without hesitation or contradiction.
sentences.zh: 当哈罗德走上证人席时，他显得很镇定，表现比在研讯时好得多，回答问题时毫不犹豫也没有矛盾。

sentences.en: His cross-examination was rigorous and lengthy, but Harold remained composed throughout.
sentences.zh: 他的盘问严厉而漫长，但哈罗德始终保持镇定。

sentences.en: The prosecution labelled Harold as heartless and someone with tremendous ability to control his emotions.
sentences.zh: 控方给哈罗德贴上了冷酷无情以及拥有极强情绪控制能力的标签。

sentences.en: The trial only lasted one day, after which the jury of seven men and five women retired for five hours.
sentences.zh: 审判只持续了一天，随后由七名男性和五名女性组成的陪审团退席商议了五个小时。

sentences.en: They returned with a unanimous decision.
sentences.zh: 他们带着一致的裁决回来了。

sentences.en: For the willful murder of Frieda Burnell,
sentences.zh: 关于蓄意谋杀弗里达·伯内尔一案，

sentences.en: 15-year-old Harold Jones was found not guilty.
sentences.zh: 15岁的哈罗德·琼斯被判无罪。

sentences.en: The town of Abitaliri rejoiced.
sentences.zh: 阿比塔利里镇陷入了欢庆。

sentences.en: Harold walked free from the courtroom and into the arms of his tearful parents.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德走出了法庭，投入了泪流满面的父母的怀抱。

sentences.en: To celebrate,
sentences.zh: 为了庆祝，

sentences.en: Harold and his family went for high tea at a local motel, a luxury reserved for only the most special of occasions.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德和家人去当地的一家汽车旅馆吃下午茶，这是一种只有在最特殊场合才能享有的奢侈待遇。

sentences.en: Locals accompanied him to share in the celebration.
sentences.zh: 当地人陪同他一起分享这份喜悦。

sentences.en: Some reports say that they presented him with a gold watch, with everyone who knew him to be innocent chipping in.
sentences.zh: 一些报道称，他们送给他一块金表，所有知道他是清白的人都出资凑钱。

sentences.en: Harold thanked his supporters.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德感谢了他的支持者们。

sentences.en: Despite his ordeal, which he described as horrendous, he said that he didn't hold a grudge against the townspeople.
sentences.zh: 尽管经历了这场他形容为可怕的磨难，但他表示自己并不记恨镇民。

sentences.en: He then jumped into an open-topped vehicle decorated with fresh flowers and was driven through the streets of Abitaliri.
sentences.zh: 随后，他跳上一辆用鲜花装饰的敞篷车，在阿比塔利里的街道上游行。

sentences.en: Supporters lined the footpaths waving flags as Harold received a hero's welcome.
sentences.zh: 支持者们排在人行道两侧挥舞着旗帜，哈罗德受到了英雄般的欢迎。

sentences.en: They blamed the Scotland Yard detectives for implicating the teenager through circumstantial evidence, despite so many people providing evidence
sentences.zh: 他们指责苏格兰场警探通过间接证据牵连这名少年，尽管有那么多人提供了证据

sentences.en: that he could not have committed the crime.
sentences.zh: 证明他不可能犯下这起罪行。

sentences.en: As Harold made his way home, his neighbour, George Little, clapped him on the back and said,
sentences.zh: 正当哈罗德回家时，他的邻居乔治·利特尔拍了拍他的背说：

sentences.en: Well done, lad.
sentences.zh: 干得好，孩子。

sentences.en: We knew you didn't do it.
sentences.zh: 我们知道你没干这事。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: “案卷档案”节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持“案卷档案”继续为您带来优质内容。

sentences.en: On Friday, July 8, 1921,
sentences.zh: 1921年7月8日，星期五，

sentences.en: 11-year-old Florence Little completed her homework, ate her dinner, and did her nightly chores.
sentences.zh: 11岁的弗洛伦斯·利特尔写完了作业，吃过晚饭，并做完了她晚上的杂务。

sentences.en: At 9pm, she asked her father, George, if she could go outside and play for a while.
sentences.zh: 晚上9点，她问父亲乔治自己是否可以出去玩一会儿。

sentences.en: With his permission,
sentences.zh: 在得到他的允许后，

sentences.en: Florence met her good friend,
sentences.zh: 弗洛伦斯遇到了她的好朋友，

sentences.en: Flossie Jones, outside on Daron Street,
sentences.zh: 弗洛西·琼斯，在达隆街上，

sentences.en: Abba Tilleri.
sentences.zh: 阿巴蒂勒里。

sentences.en: As the two young girls lived just a few doors from one another, they played together often.
sentences.zh: 由于这两个小女孩只相隔几道门，她们经常一起玩耍。

sentences.en: That night, they skipped along playing hopscotch, unaware that someone was watching them.
sentences.zh: 那天晚上，她们一边蹦蹦跳跳地玩着跳房子，一边却没有意识到有人在注视着她们。

sentences.en: Afterwards, the pair headed to Flossie's home, but Flossie soon left to visit an aunt in a neighbouring street.
sentences.zh: 之后，两人前往弗洛西家，但弗洛西很快就离开去拜访一条邻街的姑妈。

sentences.en: She bid farewell to her friend before heading out the door.
sentences.zh: 她在出门前向朋友道了别。

sentences.en: Florence didn't return to her own home, instead staying at the Jones house.
sentences.zh: 弗洛伦斯没有回家，而是留在了琼斯家。

sentences.en: She wasn't alone.
sentences.zh: 她并不是一个人。

sentences.en: Also present was Flossie's older brother,
sentences.zh: 在场的还有弗洛西的哥哥，

sentences.en: 15-year-old Harold Jones.
sentences.zh: 15岁的哈罗德·琼斯。

sentences.en: It had been 17 days since he was acquitted for the murder of Frieda Burnell to the jubilation of his town.
sentences.zh: 距离他因谋杀弗里达·伯内尔一案被判无罪并引发全镇狂欢，已经过去了17天。

sentences.en: According to differing reports,
sentences.zh: 根据不同的报道，

sentences.en: Harold either invited
sentences.zh: 哈罗德要么是邀请

sentences.en: Florence to stay for a glass of lemonade or asked her to assist him in running an errand.
sentences.zh: 弗洛伦斯留下来喝杯柠檬水，要么是请她帮忙跑个腿。

sentences.en: Since Harold's trial,
sentences.zh: 自从哈罗德受审以来，

sentences.en: Florence had been cautious around him, but she ultimately accepted his offer.
sentences.zh: 弗洛伦斯对他就一直心存戒备，但她最终还是接受了他的邀请。

sentences.en: The rest of the Joneses were out at the time, leaving Florence alone with Harold.
sentences.zh: 琼斯一家的其他人当时都不在，这使得弗洛伦斯独自和哈罗德待在一起。

sentences.en: He shut and locked the front door.
sentences.zh: 他关上并锁上了前门。

sentences.en: Around an hour later,
sentences.zh: 大约一个小时后，

sentences.en: Florence's mother,
sentences.zh: 弗洛伦斯的母亲，

sentences.en: Elsie, arrived at the Jones residence.
sentences.zh: 埃尔西，来到了琼斯家。

sentences.en: She knocked on the door and after about two minutes,
sentences.zh: 她敲了敲门，大约两分钟后，

sentences.en: Harold answered.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德来开门了。

sentences.en: He was shirtless and smiling.
sentences.zh: 他光着膀子，面带微笑。

sentences.en: He told Elsie that he had just been taking a bath.
sentences.zh: 他告诉埃尔西自己刚刚在洗澡。

sentences.en: She asked if he had seen Florence as she hadn't returned from playing with Flossie.
sentences.zh: 她问他有没有看到弗洛伦斯，因为她和弗洛西玩耍后一直没有回家。

sentences.en: Harold said that she had been at the house, but left earlier via a back door with the intention of going home.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德说她确实来过家里，但早些时候从后门离开了，打算回家。

sentences.en: Elsie looked for her daughter throughout the surrounding streets but failed to find her.
sentences.zh: 埃尔西在周围的街道上到处寻找女儿，但没有找到。

sentences.en: Nervous and scared, she phoned the local police who commenced their own search at 11.15pm.
sentences.zh: 她又急又怕，给当地警方打了电话，警方于晚上11点15分开始自行搜寻。

sentences.en: Word quickly spread and just as they had done with Frida Burnell five months earlier, locals gathered to look for another little girl.
sentences.zh: 消息迅速传开，正如五个月前寻找弗里达·伯内尔时那样，当地人再次聚集起来寻找另一个小女孩。

sentences.en: Coal miners who were due to start work at 5am left their warm beds to search in the freezing cold.
sentences.zh: 原本定于清晨5点上班的煤矿工人们离开了温暖的床铺，在严寒中进行搜寻。

sentences.en: Among the many locals looking for Florence was Harold Jones who returned home at 3.30am.
sentences.zh: 在众多寻找弗洛伦斯的当地人中，就包括在凌晨3点半回到家的哈罗德·琼斯。

sentences.en: Harold climbed out of bed the following morning and ate breakfast, all the while seeming his normal self.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，哈罗德起床吃早餐，一如往常般表现得十分正常。

sentences.en: A short while later, police officers arrived to question him in relation to Florence Little's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，警官们赶到并就弗洛伦斯·利特尔的失踪一事对他进行盘问。

sentences.en: He calmly smoked a cigarette while telling them that Florence had arrived at his doorstep the night before but then ran off.
sentences.zh: 他平静地抽着烟，告诉他们弗洛伦斯前一天晚上确实来到了他家门前，但随后就跑开了。

sentences.en: After the interview,
sentences.zh: 盘问结束后，

sentences.en: Harold strolled outside to visit some friends a few streets away.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德溜达着去拜访几条街外的一些朋友。

sentences.en: Given that he had just been involved in a murder trial involving a very similar incident, the police weren't convinced that Harold had nothing to do with Florence's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 鉴于他刚刚卷入了一起性质非常相似的谋杀案审判，警方并不相信哈罗德与弗洛伦斯的失踪无关。

sentences.en: Officers spoke with Harold's father,
sentences.zh: 警官们与哈罗德的父亲，

sentences.en: Philip Jones, and advised him that they wanted to search his house.
sentences.zh: 菲利普·琼斯交谈，并告知他们想要搜查他的房子。

sentences.en: He replied,
sentences.zh: 他回答说：

sentences.en: Very well.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Come along.
sentences.zh: 进来吧。

sentences.en: A rudimentary search of the Jones home uncovered nothing that raised suspicion.
sentences.zh: 对琼斯家进行的基础搜查没有发现任何令人起疑的东西。

sentences.en: However, it looked as though the kitchen walls had been recently cleaned with white marks streaked across them.
sentences.zh: 然而，厨房的墙壁看起来像是最近刚清洗过，上面有一道道白色的痕迹。

sentences.en: An examination of Harold's clothes revealed seven ladies' handkerchiefs stuffed into some trouser pockets.
sentences.zh: 对哈罗德衣服的检查发现，有些裤兜里塞着七条女士手帕。

sentences.en: These discoveries prompted a more thorough inspection of the home.
sentences.zh: 这些发现促使警方对房屋进行了更彻底的检查。

sentences.en: A check under the kitchen sink revealed a bloodied pocket knife.
sentences.zh: 检查厨房水槽下方时，发现了一把带血的折叠刀。

sentences.en: Harold's father later claimed that the blood on the knife was his, as he had cut his finger slaughtering a chicken a week earlier.
sentences.zh: 哈罗德的父亲后来声称，刀上的血是他的，因为他一周前宰鸡时割破了手指。

sentences.en: But this didn't explain a saucepan filled with bloody water that was found alongside the knife or a blood-stained plank of wood discovered behind the kitchen coal burner.
sentences.zh: 但这无法解释与刀一起被发现的装满血水的平底锅，也无法解释在厨房燃煤炉后面发现的一块沾有血迹的木板。

sentences.en: The rooms upstairs were re-examined.
sentences.zh: 楼上的房间被重新检查了一遍。
